purpose: Acceptance criteria for replacing catalog-based enrichment. evaluation.enrichment_check performs offline structural checks; source and semantic review remain manual.
global_requirements: Every proposed factual field must have supporting source evidence.
User assertions must remain distinguishable from independently verified facts.
Unknown fields may remain unset; clarification must target missing information.
Enrichment must not change quantity or silently overwrite committed inventory.
Retrieval failure must be distinguishable from a successful search with no matching part.
Equivalent descriptions and package aliases are acceptable when supported by evidence.
